verify_first.label: Resolve this before anything else
verify_first.body: Whether your military SIC time qualifies is now the biggest open question. Strict PIC is 125.8/250 (50%), which leaves 124.2 hrs, while only 122.9 hrs remain to reach 750 total. If the SIC time doesn't count, nearly every remaining hour has to be PIC. If it does, PIC+qualifying-SIC is already 427.1/250. Confirm with Propel or your recruiter before planning around either number. The earlier Seminole PIC concern is closed: training flights before the add-on count as dual received, and only the 1.7-hr 11/18 checkride counts as multi-engine PIC so far.

stalled.label: Stalled — cross-country, night and instrument
stalled.body: None of the 32.3 hrs logged since the 10/5 review added cross-country, night or instrument time. Cross Country is still 374.3/500 (75%), Night 52.8/100 (53%), Instrument 43.2/75 (58%) and PIC Cross Country 58.3/100 (58%). Cross Country is the tightest: 125.7 hrs remain for the full 500, more than the 122.9 hrs left to 750, so even an all-XC finish lands 2.8 hrs short at 750. You're already above the 200-hr floor for a Restricted ATP; anything under 500 means the restricted certificate rather than a full ATP.

resolving_naturally.label: Milestone crossed — Commercial Multi-Engine passed
resolving_naturally.body: You passed the Commercial Multi-Engine add-on on 11/18, four weeks after the Commercial Single-Engine checkride on 10/22. Multi-Engine Land is 45.3/25 (181%) and needs no more attention. From here, flights where you're sole manipulator in the Seminole can count as PIC, so multi-engine flying now helps the PIC minimum instead of only total time.

highest_leverage.label: Highest-leverage move for total hours
highest_leverage.body: 627.1/750 (84%), with 122.9 hrs left. You've added 32.3 hrs since the 10/5 review, about 22 hrs/month, down from about 28. At that rate you reach 750 in roughly five and a half months (around early May 2027). What you fly now matters more than how much: one night cross-country as PIC counts toward Total, PIC, Night, Cross Country, PIC Cross Country and PIC Night at once. With both Commercial checkrides done, build those flights into the CFI phase and instructor time wherever you can.

lagging.label: Lagging without a natural fix
lagging.body: PIC Night: 6.4/25 (26%) is still the minimum furthest from done, with 18.6 hrs left and no change since 10/5. It only moves on deliberately scheduled night flights as PIC. Those same hours also count toward Night (47.2 hrs left), and if flown cross-country they count toward PIC Cross Country (41.7 hrs left) too.
